description: Friendly, clean, light-hearted roasts — playful teasing from templates, never cruel. Pick a vibe and roast away.

faqs.a: Every roast is clean and good-natured — playful teasing about harmless things, never about looks, identity, or anything sensitive.
Type a name (or nickname) and the generator weaves it into the roast.
faqs.q: Can I roast a specific person?

faqs.a: Choose Goofy, Nerdy, Lazy, or Dramatic for a themed batch of roasts.
Yes — every roast can be copied with one click.

title: Playful Roast Generator
